provider_policy.market: Corrected event engine, fresh real match odds required for every fixture, no editorial overrides or FC27 ratings
provider_policy.statistical: Fixed ridge penalty 100, train 2023/24 with at least one prior GW, evaluate 2024/25 without tuning; current lagged points/minutes/xG/xA and official availability
provider_policy.hybrid: 0.5 market + 0.5 statistical, prespecified without fitting; do not describe as optimized
provider_policy.consensus: 0.5 official ep_next + 0.5 FFIQ where matched; official alone otherwise, with coverage disclosed. External training/data lineage unknown
provider_policy.blanks_and_doubles: Known blanks are zero; statistical values scale with upcoming fixture count (approximation)

promotion: No automatic winner selection; assess paired forecast loss, decisions, uncertainty and model versions
scope: Virtual prospective squads. No official FPL accounts are created or operated. Existing published squads are a separate historical record.
